scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns integral homology representations for finite complete multipartite graphs and rational homology of finite-group orbit spaces; it does not determine equivariant homotopy or integral torsion of the orbit spaces. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Integral equivariant homology and rational symmetry quotients of higher independence complexes of complete multipartite graphs
